apiKey.keyFor: A ChatGPT account signed in to the ChatGPT desktop app (no API key needed)

evidence.quote: 已在桌面 App 登录，并能正常发送聊天消息。

checkNote: Both quotes are in the pack. The plugin needs a ChatGPT account signed in to the desktop app ('已在桌面 App 登录，并能正常发送聊天消息。'), which counts as a sign-in of the user's own, even though the README says '不需要 API Key'. It relays to the ChatGPT app, not a local model.
